# The commit test checks that a refused create can reload immediately after Replan, before planning
# can clear stale state. The folder test checks the database before restart, where load-time cleanup
# would mask the same bug. The existing move and recovery tests now check which transitions release
# a position watch and which keep it. None of those tests previously checked the watch lifetime.
# The ID_EXISTS regression checks preservation of both values without uploading into the excluded
# path. The parked-child and removal tests distinguish R-only occupancy from a fresh child, and
# the evidence matrix makes each source independently testable. Existing tests don't separate them.
# The reverted-folder test covers a new entry under a folder whose move the server refused, which
# no other test reaches: every existing prospective-path test moves or renames the folder on the server.
